bp-484px.query: screen and (max-width: 484px) and (orientation: portrait), screen and (max-width: 736px) and (orientation: landscape)

visual.description: Single-row full-width banner with centered text and an underlined CTA link on a light purple/lavender background.
Top utility bar with Account, Cart, and Checkout links aligned to the right side of the viewport.
Three-zone horizontal nav: logo anchored left, main nav links centered, search bar plus Subscribe CTA on the right.
Full-bleed gradient image background with a left half containing large display type and a right half containing a newsletter signup form with email input.
Single horizontal row of category filter tabs (Featured, How To, Trends, etc.) spanning the full content width with underline on active state.
Horizontal scrolling row of four equal-width article cards, each with image on top and category label plus title below.
Full-bleed section with oversized display text spanning nearly the full viewport width, with decorative emoji icons interspersed inline.
Three-zone horizontal band on a light purple background: left column has headline with dark color block, center has body copy and CTA button, right has a decorative collage illustration.
Centered section with oversized heading and a CTA button, flanked by a large collage illustration on the left and empty space on the right.
Single-row full-width ticker/marquee of job category labels separated by star glyphs, scrolling horizontally.
Horizontal carousel of four equal-width cards showing guide cover images with italic serif titles and subtitles below.
Full-bleed yellow/orange gradient background with large logotype-style display text on the left and body copy plus episode description below.
Three-column equal-width grid of article cards, each with a full-bleed image and category label plus italic title below.
Two-column layout on a pastel gradient background: left column has heading and Subscribe CTA button, right column has three stacked pull-quote testimonials in italic text.
Dark background footer with logo and tagline plus social icons in the left zone, two columns of navigation links in the center-right, all above a copyright line.
